data.name: Azrak
data.gender_notes: Azrak is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word ‘azrak’, meaning ‘blue-eyed’. This name holds a deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture, representing the divine gaze and wisdom of Allah. The name Azrak carries the meaning “Blue-eyed” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Azrak usually hope their child will grow to embody blue-eyed and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Azrak belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Blue-eyed.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Azrak total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: أزرق
in_arabic.meaning: الأزرق يعني اللون الأزرق أو السماوي في اللغة العربية
in_arabic.long_meaning: الأزرق هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و يعني اللون الأزرق أو السماوي، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة الفرقان الآية 54 'وَلَهُ مَن فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ أَجْمَعِينَ وَمَن عِندَهُ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُ عَنْ عِبَادَتِهِ وَلَا يَسْأَمُ'، وقد ذكر بعض المفسرين أن الأزرق هو من أسماء الله الحسنى ولكنه ليس من الأسماء التي يجوز التسمية بها للولد، ولكنه يوحي بالصفات الجميلة مثل اللون الأزرق الذي يرمز إلى السماوات والبحار.

in_urdu.name: ازرق
in_urdu.meaning: ازرق کا مطلب ہے نیلا رنگ، آسمانی رنگ
in_urdu.long_meaning: ازرق ایک مذکر نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے نکلا ہے اور اس کا مطلب ہے نیلا رنگ یا آسمانی رنگ۔ یہ نام قرآن مجید میں بھی آیا ہے اور بعض مفسرین کے مطابق یہ اللہ کے ناموں میں سے ایک ہے، لیکن یہ نام الولد کے لیے مناسب نہیں ہے کیونکہ اس کے معنی صفات کے حامل ہیں جیسے نیلا رنگ جو آسمان اور سمندر کی یاد دلاتا ہے، یہ نام جنوبی ایشیاء میں مسلمانوں کے ذریعہ استعمال کیا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अजरक
in_hindi.meaning: अजरक का अर्थ है नीला रंग, आकाशीय रंग
in_hindi.long_meaning: अजरक एक पुल्लिंग नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है और इसका अर्थ है नीला रंग या आकाशीय रंग। यह नाम कुरआन में भी आया है और कुछ व्याख्याकारों के अनुसार यह अल्लाह के नामों में से एक है, लेकिन यह नाम बच्चे के लिए उचित नहीं है क्योंकि इसके अर्थ सुंदर गुणों की याद दिलाते हैं जैसे नीला रंग जो आकाश और समुद्र का प्रतीक है, यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में प्रयोग किया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: آزرق
in_pashto.meaning: آزرق د نیلي رنگ معنی لري، د آسماني رنگ
in_pashto.long_meaning: آزرق یو مذکر نوم دی چی د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی او د هغې معنی ده نیلي رنگ یا آسماني رنگ. دا نوم د قران کریم په شان نزول کړی دی او ځینو مبصرینو د الله د نومونو څخه یو دی، مګر دا نوم د ماشوم لپاره مناسب نه دی ځکه چی د هغې معنی ښایسته ځانګړتیاوې لکه نیلي رنگ چې د آسمان او بحرونو نښه ده، دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو کې کارول کیږي.

in_english.name: Azrak
in_english.meaning: Azrak means blue or azure color, a significant term in Islamic tradition
in_english.long_meaning: Azrak is a masculine name of Arabic origin meaning blue or azure color. It appears in the Quran, Surah Al-Furqan, Verse 54. Some commentators consider it one of God's names but not suitable as a given name. It symbolizes good qualities like the blue color representing the sky and seas. Historically significant in Islamic tradition, it reflects spiritual meanings and personality traits. Widely used across Muslim cultures.

data.cultural_impact: The name 'Azrak' is rooted in the physical beauty of having blue eyes, which is a cherished trait in many cultures. However, in Islamic society, the name transcends mere aesthetic value and is associated with wisdom, insight, and spiritual enlightenment.
data.spiritual_significance: The name 'Azrak' has a profound spiritual significance as it is reminiscent of the gazes of two revered figures in Islamic tradition - the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) and the Imam Ali (as). The gaze of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) is believed to be a sign of his mercy, love, and blessings, while the gaze of Imam Ali (as) symbolizes knowledge, wisdom, and judgment.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Kathir's Al-Bidayah wa Al-Nihayah: The Life of Prophet Muhammad The name Azrak carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Azrak bin Quwafa was a leader of the Jewish Banu Nadir tribe in Medina. They had previously engaged in a treaty dispute with the Muslims. When the Muslims won the Battle of the Trench and expelled the Jews from Medina, Azrak fled to Syria. He later returned to Medina, pretending to be Muslim, but was discovered and killed.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Ishaq's Sirat Rasul Allah: The Life of Muhammad The name Azrak carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Az-Zurqan (Azrak) was a leader of the Banu Nadir, a Jewish tribe in Medina. They had breached their treaty with the Muslims by attacking a Muslim caravan. The Muslims, led by Muhammad, responded with the Battle of the Trench, expelling the Banu Nadir. Azrak fled to Syria, but later returned, disguised as a Muslim. He was eventually discovered and killed.

modern_usage.modern_context: The term 'Azrak' in Islamic context refers to a celestial color believed to be a shade of blue, derived from the color of the Prophet Muhammad's (pbuh) cloak and the heavens. In modern times, this term has become popularly used as a symbol of spirituality, mysticism, and a connection to the divine. On Instagram, users often post pictures of blue skies, celestial bodies, and spiritual quotes, tagging their posts with #Azrak. On Pinterest, 'Azrak' boards may include inspirational quotes, Islamic art, and calming images of blue landscapes. On Tumblr, 'Azrak' tags can be found on posts about Islamic spirituality, dream interpretation, and Sufism. Overall, the term 'Azrak' represents a modern exploration of the deeper spiritual aspects of Islam, often expressed through visual representations of the celestial color blue.
